display_long_description:
Geo Voyage is a developer reference app designed to show developers how to build spatialized experiences using the Meta Spatial SDK. With a visually stunning 3D globe and interactive features, this app brings the world to your fingertips.

**Explore the Globe:** Spin the globe to reveal famous landmarks and wonders worldwide. Tap any location to learn exciting facts and dive into immersive experiences. Street view maps and panoramic photos transport you to the heart of your chosen destination, allowing you to explore as if you were there.

**Ask Earth AI:** Have questions about the world? Geo Voyage ’s AI companion will tell you what you want to know about geography, culture, and more. Ask Earth your question and reveal an exciting new way to learn.

**Daily Challenges:** Engage in daily challenges that test your world knowledge. Learn about different cultures and historical events while exploring the globe.

**Discover the World:** Whether you’re a curious traveler, a history enthusiast, or simply looking for a new way to explore our planet, Geo Voyage  offers a unique and engaging experience. Download now and embark on your global adventure!

**More about Geo Voyage:**

https://developers.meta.com/horizon/documentation/spatial-sdk/geo-voyage-overview

**More about Meta Spatial SDK:**

https://developers.meta.com/horizon/develop/spatial-sdk
